questions.subject: Programming skills · State
questions.text: A digital greenhouse has a water button. Which state change could represent watering?
questions.explanation: A moisture value models a relevant part of the simulation.

questions.subject: Programming skills · State
questions.text: A cart keeps moving after Pause is clicked. What should be inspected?
answers: Whether its movement update is still enabled
questions.explanation: Pausing must stop or disable the code that advances movement.

questions.subject: Programming skills · State
questions.text: A simulation restarts. Which action makes its starting behavior predictable?
answers: Randomize every value without a rule
Initialize its state to documented starting values
Keep arbitrary values from an old run
questions.explanation: Known initial values make behavior repeatable and testable.

questions.subject: Programming skills · State
questions.text: A visitor clicks Start twice. Which rule prevents two concurrent timers?
answers: Ignore Start while a timer is already running
Create another timer on every click
Delete Pause after the first click
questions.explanation: A running-state check prevents duplicate timer creation.
